definition: A markdown file of persistent instructions that Claude Code reads at the start of every session. Scopes: managed policy (organization), `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (user), `./CLAUDE.md` (project, shared via source control) and `./CLAUDE.local.md` (personal, add to `.gitignore`).
whyItMatters: It's context, not enforced configuration: to block an action regardless of what Claude decides, use a PreToolUse hook. Keep it specific and concise (target under 200 lines).
example: Run `/init` to generate a starting CLAUDE.md; import other files with `@path/to/import`.
